newsitem.title: USA: Loral expects positive earnings by 1999.
newsitem.headline: Loral expects positive earnings by 1999.

text.p: Loral Space & Communications Ltd, reporting a second-quarter loss, said Wednesday it expected to see revenues accelerate in the second half and projected a profit by 1999.

"We expect to see accelerated revenues and EBITDA in the second half of the year and beyond," said chief executive Bernard Schwartz in a statement. "By 1999 .... we expect to generate positive earnings."

The satellite manufacturer posted a net loss of $13.2 million, or $0.06 a share, on revenues of $291.2 million. Loral said its 1996 results are not meaningful because it started operations in April 1996 and did not account for its Space Systems/Loral unit results on a consolidated basis.
Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization were $20.8 milion for the quarter.

Schwartz said the company should post higher revenues in the second half because of increased contributions from its Skynet unit's recent satellite launch and improving margins at the Space Systems/Loral unit.
The company's stock traded at 16-1/4, up 3/8, Wednesday afternoon.
